correctness.rationale: For the explicit 21-vertex Brinkmann graph, independent bitset recursion enumerated exactly 4,362 nonempty independent faces with f-vector (21,168,658,1344,1400,665,106). Reimplemented deterministic vertex toggles: exactly 2,176 pairs and critical cells one vertex/eight 4-faces/one 5-face; whole directed Hasse graph has 19,418 arrows and topological sorting visited all 4,362 nodes, proving acyclicity. Independently reconstructed the signed Morse boundary of 5-cell as primitive (1,-2,1,1,-1,-1,1,-1), giving wedge of 7 S^4 integrally (cell attaching vector unit after integer basis change). Generic flag support bound minimal 2d+2=10, equality requires an induced matching of five disjoint forbidden edges; exhaustive five-edge induced matching enumeration gives precisely 21 ten-vertex supports. Integer cycles on those octahedral spheres are genuine simplicial cycles with primitive projected coordinates. All 14 automorphisms were enumerated and the three size-7 D7 orbit ranks/determinants computed (6,0),(7,+1),(7,-1); reflection acts without sign on each integral basis orbit, yielding Z[D7/C2]. These exhaustive checks prove only this finite named graph theorem.
residual_risks: The minimal-support generic lemma uses flag status essentially, not any arbitrary simplicial complex. Exact graph encoding in source controls claim, not any other possibly named Brinkmann graph variants.
